asset: Deployed ScanShield classifier and the early-warning signal it provides
attacker_objective: Enumerate open ports without any flow crossing the alert threshold
capability: Black box: no access to the model, its scores or its training data. Full control of their own scanning host, so they can shape probe timing, payload length, TCP window and handshake completion.
attack_surface: The flow features are derived from the attacker's own packets
attack_tested: Feature-space evasion by traffic shaping: 5 attacks (timing, payload padding, TCP-window reshaping, handshake mimicry, all combined), applied offline to held-out scan flows
defense_tested: Adversarial training: the same shaping transforms applied to training scan flows and added to the training set, model refit
environment: Offline only, on the public CICIDS2017 research dataset. No live scanning, no traffic generated, no system contacted.
